I am the Trailseer. Last night I followed player_8, and my result shows they visited me.

That is a very specific result from player_7. player_8, did you actually visit player_7 last night, and if so, can you explain what your role's business was with them without fully claiming if you don't have to?

Yes, I did visit player_7. I'm the Sigilist, and I placed a sigil on them last night. Since it had no effect, we know player_7 didn't attack anyone, which aligns with them being the Trailseer who spent the night following me.

The interaction between player_7 and player_8 is incredibly clean. A Trailseer following someone who happened to place a sigil on them creates a perfect loop that is very hard for evil roles to fake-claim on the spot without coordination. We should treat them both as highly likely Town for now.

The interaction between player_7 and player_8 definitely feels genuine and gives us a solid starting point. With player_3 gone, we need to be careful, so I'd like to hear from some of the quieter folks. player_6, what are your thoughts on the claims so far?

I think the interaction between player_7 and player_8 looks highly genuine. It is incredibly risky for two evils to coordinate a specific claim like that so early on. Having two strong town leads this early gives us a great starting core to build on.

Last night, I followed player_1 and they visited no one, so they didn't carry out either of the attacks on me.

Thanks for the clear, player_7. I did stay home last night, so your result is completely accurate. Since you survived a double attack and your info is correct, you're definitely confirmed town in my book.

Building on what player_1 said, player_7's tracking of player_1 not only confirms player_7's role, but it also heavily clears player_1 from being either the serial killer or the wolf carrier last night. Since player_7 is our confirmed trailseer and survived a double attack, the healer needs to keep them protected at all costs while we focus on finding the attackers among the remaining quiet players.

Building on player_2's point about keeping player_7 protected, we need to be careful. The wolves and the serial killer know player_7 is being healed, so they might pivot to hunting the healer or other power roles tonight instead of wasting another attack on player_7.

Building on player_2's point, while player_1 staying home mechanically clears them from being the Serial Killer—since the SK cannot be blocked and must visit to kill—it doesn't fully clear them from being a wolf. Only the wolf carrier visits for the kill, so player_1 could still be a non-carrying member of the pack.

Building on player_5's analysis of last night's attacks, I want to ask player_8 if they placed a sigil on me last night. Since I was targeted by both the wolves and the Serial Killer, any sigil on me should have triggered and struck one of them, which would give us a massive lead if player_8 got a result.

Actually, player_7, that's not how my sigil works. A sigil strikes the player it is placed on if *that* player attacks someone else, not if they are attacked. Regardless, I held onto my remaining sigil last night to save it for a better lead.

Player_7 being roleblocked last night actually makes sense if they are the real Trailseer. The wolves' Chanteuse would definitely want to keep them blind after player_8 died. Since player_8 was hit by both kills, we lost a major town asset, and the wolves used an Illusionist to hide it.

Building on player_1's point about the block, if player_7 was indeed targeted by the Chanteuse, it shows the wolves are terrified of their tracking. Also, since player_8 was hit by both kills, the Serial Killer is clearly targeting the same vocal town members as the wolves. Player_10, what was the reasoning behind your sudden push on player_9 yesterday?

Player_9's vote on me yesterday seemed reactionary rather than logical, especially when the town was clearly focused on resolving the uncertainty surrounding player_4. I voted for them because that sudden pivot felt like an attempt to shift the heat when the vote was already set. Since my checks are finished, I am now looking purely at who stood to gain from keeping the voting pool muddy yesterday.

Player_10, you mentioned your checks are finished, which strongly implies you are our Investigator. If that is the case, you should share your results with the town so we have actual reports to work with today.

Yes, player_5, I am the Investigator. On Night 1, I checked player_3, and on Night 2, I checked player_1; both came back Not suspicious. This means player_1 is definitely not a wolf, which narrows down our search significantly. Let's look closer at player_9 for that deflection vote on me yesterday.

My vote on you yesterday, player_10, was purely because you were flying completely under the radar while the town was in chaos. Now that you've claimed Investigator and cleared player_1, that actually gives us real parameters to work with. Since player_1 is clean, we should look closely at the players who have barely contributed, like player_6.

Player_9, deflecting to me the second player_10 questions your voting record is highly suspicious. I've been quiet because I'm trying to follow the claims carefully instead of adding to the noise. Why are you so eager to shift the focus away from your odd vote on player_10 yesterday?

My vote on player_10 yesterday was to pressure someone who was completely silent while we were trying to resolve the player_4 situation. Now that player_10 has claimed Investigator, that pressure served its purpose by forcing out crucial information for the town. But player_6, you're still just spectating and attacking me for trying to get quiet players to talk, which doesn't help us find the wolves.

Building on player_10's Investigator claim, since player_1 is confirmed Not Suspicious and my Night 2 track showed them visiting no one, player_1 is highly cleared. This makes player_9's sudden vote shift to player_10 yesterday look even more defensive. Player_9, if your pressure was just to get information, why did you immediately try to push the lynch onto a quiet player like player_6 instead of engaging with the confirmed data?

player_7, I didn't push a lynch on player_6; I pointed out that we have zero information on them while we now have solid parameters for others. With you, player_10, and player_1 mostly cleared, looking at the completely silent slots like player_6 is the only logical way to find the remaining threats. If we only focus on the vocal players, the quiet ones glide right to the end.
Before the vote: player_9 has been accused by player_6 and player_7. player_9 gets a last word.

My vote on player_10 yesterday was meant as pressure to get a silent slot to contribute, which ultimately succeeded in revealing our Investigator. Now that we have player_10, player_7, and player_1 highly cleared, finding the remaining threats is a simple process of elimination. Looking toward unconfirmed and quiet players like player_6 isn't a deflection; it is the most logical way for Town to narrow down the pool of suspects today.

By claiming healer now, they're just trying to deflect from the fact that they're the one who killed player 10 while I was busy protecting our trailseer.

Player_6, your timeline is completely fabricated. I claimed Healer and listed my exact protections on player_7 at the very start of today, before player_7 even revealed they followed you. You only claimed Healer after being cornered by player_7's track, making it obvious you're the Serial Killer trying to escape the noose.

Player 5 is clearly a wolf making a desperate play. If they were the real healer, they would have stepped forward far sooner rather than waiting for player 7 to reveal my visit. day_channel.message: Player_6, your defense doesn't hold up. You claim player_5 waited for me to reveal my track before claiming Healer, but the record shows player_5 claimed Healer at the very start of today, before I had said a single word. Since player_5 claimed first, they couldn't have known I tracked you, which confirms player_6 is the Serial Killer trying to lie their way out.

Player 7, your track confirms I was there, but you are misinterpreting the visit. I am the Healer, and I visited you to provide the protection that kept you alive during those attacks. Player 5's late claim is a desperate attempt by a wolf to seize credit and shift blame onto me after their pack's losses.
Before the vote: player_6 has been accused by player_1, player_5 and player_7. player_6 gets a last word.

If player_5 is a wolf, they already knew player_7 survived multiple nights and that a Healer was actively protecting them. Claiming Healer first today was their only viable play to steal credit for those saves before the real Healer could speak up. My visit to player_7 was a genuine protection, and letting a wolf fake-claim Healer to lynch the actual protector will leave our Trailseer completely defenseless tonight.
